bias_check.principle: Markets price expectations, not your conviction — weigh valuation, the macro and the data, not just the story.

flags.title: Valuation blind-spot
flags.note: Rich valuation — P/E 77, P/B 21.7, DCF overvalued 237%. A market-beating chart doesn't make a rich entry safe; the price already discounts a lot of the good news.
flags.lesson: KPIT: strong EV/software story, valuation ignored → about −30%.

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

Shareholder capital is compounding at a high rate.

Technical score 100/100 - RS rating 100 (market-beating); +45% vs Nifty 500 (3M); above 200-DMA

Operating margin has widened over the last few years.

The net profit trend has been rising for 4 years in a row.

opportunities.point: Management expects at least 60-70% growth rate on a conservative side for the full year FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So, based on the conservative side, we can say that at least we achieve 60-70% growth rate on a very conservative side that we are pretty much confident on that things, right." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company targets approximately 60% to 70% growth rate in the coming years.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So, we think that the growth rate actually we expecting in the next coming few years are approximately this 60-70% at least." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: In July, the company commissioned a new assembling line adding 8 lakh units a year and taking capacity from 16 lakhs to 24 lakhs units.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "In July, we commissioned a new assembling line, adding 8 lakh units a year and taking our assembling capacity from 16 lakhs to 24 lakhs unit, an increase of 50%." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company commissioned a new assembly line, increasing annual capacity by 50% to 24 lakh units.

opportunities.point: A capex build-up is underway, pointing to future capacity.
opportunities.evidence: CWIP 2 Cr -> 12 Cr (500%) as of Mar 2026

opportunities.point: Sales are outgrowing costs - operating leverage should widen margins.

opportunities.point: Demand is not an issue as there is a lot of demand in the market.

opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "So as of now, the peak season starting from the Q3 and the highest into the Q4, right? So, sales majorly come into the Q4." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Currently, our finished camera assembly capacity stands at 24 lakh units." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
A rich price versus intrinsic value is vulnerable to any de-rating.
threats.evidence: DCF intrinsic 443 vs price 1,492 - margin of safety -237%

threats.point: The price demands a very high growth rate to be justified.
Peers earn a better ROE - the competitive position looks weaker.
Promoter selling is a warning about insider conviction.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
There are challenges in procuring raw materials from global markets due to shortages of flash memory and other items.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "So still there are challenges into procurement of the raw materials from the global markets because of the shortage of the flash memory and all, right." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Sep) are still in the cycle.
